# Skills in this repository

Governed skills for creating and maintaining a company brain. They follow the
same format as the harness skills (`ml-python-base`) and are meant to be
distributed with it; this repo includes them so the template is self-sufficient.

| Skill | When to use it |
|---|---|
| `bootstrap_company_brain` | Instantiate and populate the brain for a new organization |
| `update_domain_context` | Absorb business changes into the domain/glossary |
| `record_decision` | Record a cross-cutting decision as an ADR |
| `add_runbook` | Turn an ad-hoc explained procedure into a runbook |
| `quarterly_context_review` | Quarterly anti-drift review of the whole brain |
